clips.title: The story
paras: The Blind Hunter is an elusive, albino bat that roosts deep within Razorfen Kraul. Unlike the ordinary bats nesting near the cavern entrances, this rare creature prowls the sunless depths of the quilboar redoubt.

Razorfen Kraul is riddled with winding briars and dark subterranean caverns. While common Kraul bats roost nearer to the surface where faint light filters in from the outside world, the Blind Hunter has adapted entirely to the furthest, darkest alcoves of the tangle. Its pale, albino hide and milky gaze are likely the result of generations spent completely isolated from natural sunlight.
